name: BioML-bench
description: Benchmark of autonomous LLM agents on end-to-end biomedical machine learning: an agent reads a task description, builds and runs its own pipeline and submits test-set predictions, which are graded by the task's original metric and placed on that task's public human leaderboard.

attributes.version: v0.1-alpha; 24-task set listed in experiments/biomlbench_v0.1a.txt at commit 673f3d8 and Table 3 of bioRxiv v3
attributes.task: End-to-end biomedical ML by autonomous agents, scored against public human leaderboards
attributes.scope_note: Four domains: drug discovery (9 tasks), protein engineering (6), single-cell omics (5) and biomedical imaging (4). Only the three molecular and omics domains are recorded; the imaging domain and the all-task Table 2 aggregate (which includes imaging) are out of scope.
attributes.source_locator: Sections 3.1-3.4; Table 1; Table 3; repository README
limitations: Scores are leaderboard percentiles: they depend on who submitted to each public leaderboard and when, not only on the task metric.
Results are per-domain aggregates over 5 to 9 tasks; per-task values are not printed.
Built on the MLE-bench scaffold; tasks are repackaged from Polaris Hub, ProteinGym and Open Problems with BioML-bench's own preparation scripts.
